column1: - This table should include structure-supported candidates after running structure prediction and US-align for all sequence candidates.

- `structure_support` is `1` only when BOTH directions meet the threshold (`tm_score_1 >= t` and `tm_score_2 >= t`). A mean on its own is not enough: TM1 0.40 + TM2 0.65 averages 0.525 while the template is covered only 40%.
- Avoid placing sequence-only candidates here; keep them in `sequence_candidates.tsv`.
- For DEER fallback evidence, keep the raw DEER metric in `deer_distance` and
`deer_rank`, mark `structure_support` according to the configured distance
cutoff, and fill TM-score fields with the US-align score when both are
- `priority_tier` is produced later by `scripts/score_candidates.py` on the
